name: AcceptProposal
description: Accept the player's marriage proposal. Only when the player has clearly asked you to marry them and you clearly say yes; never for flirting or talk about marriage.
note: Needs M.A.R.A.S, Mantella Living World - Relationships and Mantella's Advanced Actions. Asks the player Yes/No first, once per game day per NPC; choosing No blocks a retry that day.
prompt: If the player has asked you to marry them and you clearly say yes, begin your response with '{key}:'
